sections.heading: SHORT TITLE
sections.text: This Act may be cited by its short title, the “Reform Sentencing Act.”

sections.heading: PURPOSE
sections.text: The purpose of this Act is to repeal Public Law 34-251, also known as the In-game Sentencing Guidelines Act, due to its unenforceable nature and to reform the Act entirely.

sections.heading: SEVERABILITY
sections.text: If any provision of this Act, or the application thereof to any person or circumstance, is held invalid, the remainder of this Act and the application of such provision to other persons or circumstances shall not be affected thereby. They shall remain in full force and effect.

sections.heading: DEFINITIONS
sections.text: For the purposes of this Act; (a) The term “Imprisonment” means the confinement of an individual by an authorized law enforcement officer within a designated detention facility. (b) The term “Non-court imposed sentencing” means any imprisonment administered by a Law Enforcement Officer without judicial involvement or order. (c) The term “Law Enforcement Officer” means any individual being commissioned as an officer of either the Federal Government or the Municipal government whose duty is to carry out and execute laws of the United States.

sections.heading: REPEALMENT OF PUBLIC LAW 34-251
sections.text: (a) Public Law 34-251, also known as the In-game Sentencing Guidelines Act, shall be repealed in its entirety.

sections.heading: FELONY SENTENCING REFORM
sections.text: (a) Class A felonies shall have a maximum imprisonment of seventeen (17) minutes. (b) Class B felonies shall have a maximum imprisonment of fifteen (15) minutes. (c) Class C felonies shall have a maximum imprisonment of thirteen (13) minutes. (d) Class D felonies shall have a maximum imprisonment of ten (10) minutes. (e) Class E felonies shall have a maximum imprisonment of eight (8) minutes.

sections.heading: MISDEMEANOR SENTENCING REFORM
sections.text: (a) Class A misdemeanours shall have a maximum imprisonment of seven (7) minutes. (b) Class B misdemeanors shall have a maximum imprisonment of five (5) minutes. (c) Class C misdemeanors shall have a maximum imprisonment of two (2) minutes.

sections.heading: ENFORCEMENT
sections.text: (a) All Law Enforcement Officers shall impose sentences in accordance with this Act. (b) Any Law Enforcement Officer who is found not in compliance with this Act shall be subject to review by their Department or Agency. (c) This Act shall only apply to non-court-imposed sentencing, which is defined in Section 4(b) of this Act.

sections.heading: MULTI-CHARGE SENTENCING
sections.text: (a) If an individual is charged with multiple crimes, they shall not be jailed for more than thirty (30) minutes.

sentencing_rules.note: Public Law 39-267 uses felony/misdemeanor classes that are not expressly cross-walked to the A–G offense classes in the Federal Criminal Code.
